title: Donghak Peasant Revolution
summary: In 1894 a peasant army of Donghak followers, led by Jeon Bong-jun, rose at Gobu in Jeolla Province and took the provincial capital Jeonju. Korea asked Qing China for troops and Japan sent forces of its own, which helped trigger the Sino-Japanese War. Fighting with Japanese forces continued until December 1894; Jeon was captured that month and executed in March 1895.

uncertainty.note: Sources give the Gobu raid as 8 January 1894 or place the start in March 1894; the range is the year 1894, with Jeon's execution in March 1895 outside it.

as_recorded.value: began in Jeolla Province in March 1894
